C1242.title: Huabei and Baitiao Cash-Outs Become a Gray Market Chain with Commissions Up to 30%
C1242.summary: In November 2015, a Securities Daily investigation found that intermediaries converted Huabei and Baitiao credit limits into cash through fake transactions, typically charging service fees of 10% to 30%. The report said Ant Huabei had removed thousands of suspected cash-out merchants and JD.com had blocked more than 100 million yuan in risky orders; its system stopped over 95% of a batch of 90 suspicious transactions in Sichuan.
